verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's documented Shares feature grants read access to specific users, roles or accounts, can be scoped with include patterns, and can be made public to any MotherDuck account in the same cloud region. Recipients attach a share directly (e.g. 'md:_share/...') rather than receiving a copy or an export. missing for 10: explicit documentation that shares stay live and are zero-copy, private (non-public) sharing to a specific external organization, cross-region sharing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
